Maya (AE): opening swarm for Solstice POC. Customer sees median TTFT ~650ms, occasional 429 SHARD_OVERLOAD during a 500-request validation. They also pinged security questions on KMS. Looping @Owen @Jun.

Owen (SalesEng): sample request and env?

Maya (AE): hosted eu-west, model=redwood-medium. sample: {"prompt":"Parse errors id=tx-9f","max_tokens":80,"session":"s-9"} header: x-org=solstice-test

Jun (SRE): traces show repeated kvcache=MISS and batch_window spikes ~55-70ms. shards 2/5 show queue_wait >60ms. snippet: [14:20] req.. kvcache=MISS shard=2 queue_wait_ms=66 batch_window_ms=60

Ravi (Runtime): root causes: prompt-munging adds unique IDs -> cache misses; routing jitter causing cold shards. Quick fixes: enable header-scoped sticky routing for x-org, set route max_batch_window_ms=12, and enable kv_prefetch.

Tess (Product): also suggest ingress sanitizer to strip variable tokens (regex) as fallback.

sec-bot: SOC2 and KMS docs uploaded -> https://internal.redwood/security/solstice-poc.zip

Maya (AE): action items: Owen to ask customer to run 200 normalized requests; Ravi/Jun to roll sticky canary + reduced batch window; Tess to prepare sanitizer. Jun will post before/after TTFT and kvcache_hit_rate (ETA ~20m).
